selectedSlice: C — production-batch persistence + inventory-movement pure domain
purpose: Establish durable immutable production batch persistence and a pure append-only physical inventory movement vocabulary without quantity-on-hand, SKU capacity, reservation execution, or checkout/payment readiness.

migration.migration 0004: Definition created only; unexecuted; execution forbidden in this slice
migration.immutability: Both tables reject updates and deletes through stable immutable triggers.
migration.skuBinding: Redundant exact SKU reference retained; no invented durable SKU table or SKU foreign key. Equality to batch SKU is deferred to trusted service/repository logic.
migration.dateChecks: SQL checks structural YYYY-MM-DD only; canonical application validation owns full calendar validity.

batchPersistence.validation: Reuse validateFoodProductionBatchVersion; preserve canonical W1 self-validation and JSON round trips for all storage modes.
batchPersistence.otherVersions: Invalid before database access; no arbitrary physical-history revision writer.
batchPersistence.idempotency: Exact ID/version and identical entire canonical payload returns already-present; divergent payload returns conflict; different IDs create separate immutable rows.
batchPersistence.insert: Exact read, then INSERT RETURNING; created requires exactly one valid matching returned row. Failed insert rereads exact durable state: identical is already-present, divergent is conflict, absent/malformed/uncertain is storage-failure.
batchPersistence.failurePolicy: Fail closed; no raw database exceptions exposed.
batchPersistence.nonFrozenShape: SQL frozen_on NULL reconstructs omission, then canonical W1 validation; no empty string or artificial undefined output.
batchPersistence.interface: Narrow local structural prepare/bind/all interface; synthetic test double only.
batchPersistence.authority: Persistence is not authentication or authorization; no trusted service, route, runtime adapter, binding, or UI.

movementDomain.localIdentity: Caller-supplied nonempty unpadded text <=128 characters without colon; no generated IDs.
movementDomain.references: Exact branded batch ID/version and SKU ID/version; positive JS-safe versions; no latest/current resolution, lookup, or existence proof.
movementDomain.packageCount: Positive JS-safe integer; direction comes from movementType, never a signed count.
movementDomain.occurredOn: Deterministic caller-supplied valid YYYY-MM-DD calendar date; no clock access.
movementDomain.metadata: Required nonempty unpadded attribution and sourceReference, each <=512 characters.
movementDomain.strictness: Unknown string/symbol keys and missing required own keys reject, including nested references.
movementDomain.snapshot: Detached and frozen outer movement and nested batch/SKU references.
movementDomain.authority: Asserted physical evidence only; proves neither administrator identity, source truth, sufficient stock, possible removal, nor nonnegative resulting quantity.
movementDomain.productionBaseline: producedPackageCount is immutable historical production baseline, not quantity-on-hand. No production movement type to avoid duplicated authority.
movementDomain.reservationSeparation: reservation hold/release are not physical inventory movements; holds change reservable availability rather than physical quantity.
movementDomain.futureQoh: Future stocked physical quantity-on-hand may derive from producedPackageCount + adjustment-in - adjustment-out - waste - a future canonical fulfillment/handoff removal source. Explanatory only; no calculation or mutable counters implemented.
movementDomain.physicalVersusCapacity: Physical stocked inventory is distinct from made-to-order capacity.

deferred: Physical movement D1 persistence and trusted service
Sale/fulfillment/handoff removal until exact authoritative operational evidence is selected
SKU capacity derivation or writes; later stocked reservable capacity may compose physical QOH minus active reservations
FOOD-005L creation after successful authoritative reservation
delivery: Exactly six new unstaged files; no staging, commit, push, migration execution, production mutation, deployment, or FOOD-005Y.
